articles.summary: Astec Industries has launched its groundbreaking Vari-Frequency technology, implemented on its 6203 LP horizontal screen. The next-generation solution is built to boost screening performance by minimizes blinding and maximizes uptime, giving producers a smarter, more reliable way to keep processing material. Read the Equipment Journal article.
articles.title: Astec’s Vari-Frequency horizontal screen aims to redefine efficiency
